title: Pro Evolution Soccer 2009
shortDescription: Pro Evolution Soccer 2009 helps define a Wii sports path in GameAtlas through a frozen catalog method and a direct Wikidata record.
highlights: Builds a traceable sports option into the Wii discovery path.
Links the catalog entry to a source record without presenting a rating.

signals.label: GameAtlas catalog method
signals.rationale: Registered for the Wii sports discovery path using the preserved Wikidata entity record; this remains a browsable catalog record, not a score.
